label: surprise
stance: Usually not good — loss, abandonment, attack · ML samples: 1
passage: Surprise is often linked with sadness. When I'm surprised, it's usually I'm surprised by something not good. Not a lot of positive surprises in my life. My mother died November 6, almost nine months ago, and there was no funeral. My sister's not speaking to me. There's been no discussion of her estate. I've been abandoned by many people. So often surprises are related to sadness or being attacked.
